scope: Original-ROM trace of the Stage 3 Yamanokami-for-Daikon NPC exchange. Runtime prerequisites were injected into private emulator WRAM; this does not establish how to obtain the fish naturally.

exchange.condition: Stage 3 exchange flag 7E:0C1A bit 6 is clear and the keepnet contains fish ID 18.
exchange.mealInventoryBehavior: The handler writes ID 07 to every one of the 16 meal slots. It does not search for an empty slot or preserve existing meal items; a full inventory is overwritten.

codeEvidence.finding: NPC slot 22 handler checks story bit 6, requests fish ID 18 through 7E:11E8, calls the keepnet remover, sets story bit 6, then stores food ID 07 in all 16 meal slots.
Scans keepnet fish IDs at 7E:0B7A..0x0BB3 in two-byte steps. On a match, shifts later fish IDs and sizes down and clears the final slot; returns failure if no matching fish is found.
Stage 3 object pointer resolves to 00:BEB2; object slot 22's coordinate record is 00:BEE6 and encodes tile (21,82).

runtimeChecks.case: success with a populated meal inventory
runtimeChecks.preconditions: Private Stage 3 emulator state; fish ID 18 and size 0x20 injected in keepnet slot 0; all 16 meal slots prefilled with IDs 01 through 10; story bit 6 clear; player placed at tile (21,82).
runtimeChecks.action: Use the talk/action input at the Stage 3 object.
runtimeChecks.observed: The fish entry was removed, 7E:0C1A became 0x40, and all 16 meal slots became ID 07. This confirms overwrite behavior even when every slot is occupied.

runtimeChecks.preconditions: Private Stage 3 emulator state at tile (21,82), empty keepnet, story bit 6 clear, and existing meal slots containing IDs 01 and 02.
runtimeChecks.action: Use the talk/action input at the same object.
runtimeChecks.observed: Story bit 6 remained clear and the meal inventory remained unchanged.

evidenceLimit: The runtime probes directly injected the required fish and meal contents into WRAM. They verify the exchange handler, not a natural catch route or a natural save's starting inventory.
